title: platform-objects: the Setup user screens show the raw stored platform role (`user`, `admin`) because `sys_user.role` is a text field
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Ruled: 6557746678 · letter D1 · 2026-11-01T12:11Z
Ruling-ref: 6557746678

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the sys_user fold dev (PR #28065, os-dev report on #27858), carried to its own card by seat ruling A in the seat-1 thread. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: every Setup admin, today — the user record highlight and the new `all_users` Role column (PR #28065) show `user` / `admin` instead of a label.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/platform-objects`, with `driver-sql` / `schema-drift` in the question).

## What the code does (read, not measured)

`sys_user.role` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`) is `Field.text`, so every renderer shows the stored value. #27859 and #27863 asked for the role to read through its label. A label needs `Field.select` with options, but `driver-sql`'s `createColumn` emits `TEXT` for `text` and the default `varchar(255)` for `select`, so `schema-drift` would read every existing deployment's column as `narrow_varchar` (a destructive drift reading).

## Wanted (route is triage's)

Decide how the platform role reads through a label without a storage change: for example a select whose storage stays `TEXT` (a declared storage width), or a display-only label map. Measure the drift reading on an existing deployment first.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `sys_user` + `role`, `platform role`, `role label`, `select` storage width: none. **New.**

Links back: #27859, #27863, PR #28065
